rule: Unless someone says gross, 'revenue' means net revenue (gross minus refunds).
Sales is used as a synonym for revenue.
Turnover means everything paid including refunded orders.
Net revenue divided by net orders (orders neither cancelled nor refunded).
Net revenue divided by net orders (orders neither cancelled nor refunded).
Refunded orders as a share of all orders.
Cancelled orders as a share of all orders.
All orders placed, whatever their status.
Money paid back on refunded orders (an amount). "How much was refunded" means this.
An amount of money unless someone asks how many orders were refunded (then use refunded orders, or the refund rate for a share).
Everything paid including on orders that were later refunded. Cancelled orders are excluded.
